name: Kimdracula
source:
A supernatural queer romance about Dawn, a brooding immortal, and Kim, a curious human just trying to hold on to what's left of her community.

What starts as a miscommunication over antique jewelry quickly spirals into fascination and the prospect of a new love. As their connection grows, so does the looming threat of Dawn's 2,000-year-old ex, who isn't the type to let go easily.

Sink your teeth into a story of flirtation, found family, and the sharp edges of new love.

[From [url=https://theedemigawd.itch.io/kimdracula-act-one]itch.io[/url]]
